name: chain
doc: Lay a straight run of tiles as underground chain (saves belts). Tiles x1,y1 -> x2,y2 are tile CENTERS (e.g. 3.5), dir=east|west|north|south. Pairs span 6 tiles; leftover tiles are plain belts. Does no
author: serf
code:
dx = 0
dy = 0
if dir == "east":
    dx = 1
if dir == "west":
    dx = -1
if dir == "south":
    dy = 1
if dir == "north":
    dy = -1
n = abs(x2 - x1) + abs(y2 - y1) + 1
i = 0
acts = []
while i < n:
    rem = n - i
    if rem >= 3:
        k = rem
        if k > 6:
            k = 6
        acts.append({"op": "place", "name": "underground-belt", "x": x1 + dx * i, "y": y1 + dy * i, "direction": dir, "type": "input"})
        acts.append({"op": "place", "name": "underground-belt", "x": x1 + dx * (i + k - 1), "y": y1 + dy * (i + k - 1), "direction": dir, "type": "output"})
        i = i + k
    else:
        acts.append({"op": "place", "name": "transport-belt", "x": x1 + dx * i, "y": y1 + dy * i, "direction": dir})
        i = i + 1
r = act(acts)
return r
